text:
reminder that these historical valuation charts tell u nothing on their own (i.e NTM P/E)

if a multiple seems "cheap," pull charts of:

-rev growth %
-gross/ebit margin %
-eps/fcf growth %
-ROE/ROIC

you'll see the multiple tracking fundamentals. mkt isnt dumb, its never easy... https://t.co/QHAzTxOmuv
